description: Capability set for the Indigo-only desktop alternate UX window. The Meetings page self-fetches calendar data via the app's meetings_* commands directly (meetings_list_upcoming, meetings_list_scheduled_bots, meetings_list_accounts, meetings_list_calendars_for_account, meetings_list_memberships) — same as the standalone meetings-window. The Projects surface self-fetches local-PRD data via get_local_projects and get_local_project_prd (US-003, local HQ-tree reader with vault fallback), plus get_local_project_readme (US-009, reads a project's sibling README.md by its prd path with the same path-traversal guard). These are app-registered Tauri commands authorized by core:default (custom commands are not gated by per-command permission identifiers in this ACL, only plugins are), so no allow-* tokens exist or are added for them.
